Hi there, I'm Emma!

Whenever I'm not pretending to be an elite runner, I am a PhD candidate in Economics at UCL.

My primary fields are education, labour and health economics. My job market paper, [*Less to Lose: How shorter and more flexible degrees shape university choice and earnings*](https://emmascandolo.github.io/research/01_pt_bologna/), won the **2026 UniCredit Foundation Best Paper Award in Education Economics**.

I also spent summer 2026 as a PhD Intern in Amazon's Economic Decision Science team, working on EU stores.

Check out my [research](/research/) or my [CV](/cv.html), and feel free to get in touch: [emma.scandolo.21@ucl.ac.uk](mailto:emma.scandolo.21@ucl.ac.uk)
